ScriptTabs.Script:
var fn = "/home/andr/WORK/GAGG/PET/Out1M" + "/" + "CalorimeterLog.dat"
var data = core.loadNumericArray(fn)
var numS1 = 0
var numS2 = 0
var numCoinc = 0
var enWin = 0.10

hist.new1D("e1", 1000, 0, 1000)
hist.new1D("e2", 1000, 0, 1000)

var numEv = data.length
for (var iEv = 0; iEv < numEv; iEv++)
{
    var en1 = data[iEv][0]
    var en2 = data[iEv][1]
    
    hist.fill("e1", en1, 1)
    hist.fill("e2", en2, 1)
    
    var b1 = math.abs(en1-511) < enWin*511
    var b2 = math.abs(en2-511) < enWin*511
    
    if (b1 && b2) 
    {
        numCoinc++
        core.print(" Ev:", iEv)
    }
    else if (b1) numS1++
    else if (b2) numS2++
}

hist.draw("e1", "hist")
hist.draw("e2", "histsame")
core.print(numCoinc/data.length, numS1/data.length, numS2/data.length)
